submission.justification: Selection-S3 (neural network using only kinematics) at 60% signal efficiency is recommended as it achieves the highest expected signal significance among viable strategies at 3.41σ, representing a 25.7% improvement over the baseline S1 strategy. While S2 shows slightly higher significance (4.102σ at 60% efficiency), it exhibits a 35% data-MC disagreement, far exceeding the 10% tolerance threshold, making its background estimate non-robust and the strategy non-viable. S3 maintains excellent robustness with only 6% data-MC disagreement, well within tolerance, ensuring reliable background estimation. The neural network approach using only kinematic variables provides superior background rejection compared to the cut-based S1 approach (2.713σ at 50% efficiency) while maintaining robust systematic control. At the optimal working point of 60% signal efficiency, S3 satisfies all constraints: it's one of the three listed strategies, has robust background estimation (6% data-MC agreement), operates within the 20-80% efficiency range, and maximizes expected significance among viable options.
